note: A single shaded site in woods at a haul road entrance on Laurel Run Road, about 3.6 miles from PA 233 and west of the Lightner Trail. The booking page sells it as a trailer site; DCNR's 2022 campsite map layer lists it as having no trailer access and room for one vehicle. Picnic table and fire ring with grill; no toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 094 still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle and equipment length 25 ft, pull-in gravel driveway 75 ft graded Slight, clearance 15 ft, picnic table; count 1 and 25 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Year-round confirmed; sells in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri leaf-on: closed canopy; PASDA leaf-off: bare woods): the pin is about 8 m north of the forest road; no pad can be made out. NHD: Laurel Run 122 m away; not waterfront.
flags: ROAD / NAME: '(South Block)' is only the booking system's loop label. The page puts site 094 'along Laurel Run Road, about 3.6 miles from PA233. At haul road entrance, west of Lightner Trail'. Suggested name: 'Tuscarora State Forest Campsite 094 (Laurel Run Road)'. apply.py does not write names.

DCNR MAP LAYER vs BOOKING PAGE (ruling 5, reported not asked): the DCNR Designated Campsites layer (record last edited 2022-12-20) says 'TrailerAccess: No' for site 094; the booking page sells it with 'Looking For Category: Tent Site, Trailer Site' and 'Max Vehicle Length: 25'. Kept; both statements are in the note. The layer also says NumberVehicles 1.
EQUIPMENT (rulings 4 and 8, reported not raised): the page lists 'Looking For Category: Tent Site, Trailer Site' with no 'RV Site' category; Max Vehicle Length 25, Site Access Drive-In. Kept.

SMALL SITE: 'Site Length: 30', 'Site Width: 30' beside Max Vehicle Length 25 and a 75-ft driveway. A 23-ft rig fits the posted length; reported because it is the smallest site in the batch and the map layer says no trailer access.
LENGTHS (ruling 12 check): Max Vehicle Length 25 and Equipment Length 25; Driveway Length 75 and spur 75, both longer; nothing disagrees.
Overhead: 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 15' on every page of this entry; over the 10.5-ft line, nothing to act on. 'Shade: Shaded' and imagery is closed canopy.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Driveway Grade: Slight', gravel; no Site Grade line. No caution line. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).

ATV / SNOWMOBILE / HORSE (rulings 1, 12, 13, 14): no page and no GIS record of this entry contains the words ATV, snowmobile, noise, adjacent, trailhead, parking area or equestrian; nothing ties a site to an ATV system, an ATV or snowmobile lot, or a horse camp. The Tuscarora forest pages list no ATV trail (the /atv-riding page answers 404); the snowmobile page says only 'A snowmobile trail system of more than 100 miles'. The three snowmobile maps (elibrary 4818940, 3467448, 3467452) were downloaded but their parking symbols are image-only with no text layer naming lots: UNREAD for whether a lot sits at a site.
Ground: no pad identified under canopy or on leaf-off imagery; the pin stays on the agency point (page and GIS agree at 40.30064,-77.42525).
Water: NHD has Laurel Run 122 m from the site, woods between; nothing within 50 m. Not waterfront, no lead.

Tuscarora advisories page (read 2026-11-10): district office construction (mid-July to early November 2025), a chronic wasting disease notice, firewood. No road closure, gate, bridge limit or timber-sale notice. The Tuscarora camping page publishes no seasonal closure or site rotation; it says only 'State forest roads do not receive winter maintenance and are not plowed --motorized, roadside camping access is not guaranteed. Travel at your own risk.' It names one equestrian area, Showaker; this entry is not in it.
